method.published: A distributor Strong’s tag on a matching whole English verse is independently supported by a complete BSB publisher rendering of the same single word and a unique same Strong’s occurrence in the selected source verse. These flags are for lexical lookup.
method.corroborated: The WEB and ASV John 11:35 readings are independently reviewed. CrossWire KJV2003 directly identifies individual source word positions. Additions require matching English boundaries and matching Greek form, ID and position. See the build script for abstentions.
method.withheld: The raw provider archive retains every candidate. Book counts record the reason a candidate was withheld. The original translation is preserved; a supported lexical lookup does not enable source-form display.
method.publishedText: The anchored translation and literary layout are preserved from the pinned migration reference. Later distributor text revisions never silently replace a published verse.
